0.0.1.en: Ability to add BMW with Connected Drive Services

0.0.5.en: Improved capability detection for older cars. Added Remaining Fuel capability.

0.0.9.en: Added lock unlock flow for older cars. Added location capability and geofence based flow triggers. Added logging.

0.0.17.en: Added flow trigger to improve log odometer readings. Added text address capability. Added flow trigger when refuelled.

0.1.2.en: Fixed authentication issue and remote services.

0.1.5.en: Updated dependency to fix issue with talking to the BMW API.

0.1.6.en: Updated dependency to fix issue with talking to the BMW API.

0.1.7.en: Fixed issue regarding lock status and location changed trigger.

0.2.0.en: Added support for users in the North America region.

0.2.1.en: Added geofence enter and exit trigger. Added support in settings page to use the current location of the vehicle.

0.2.2.en: Added support to switch between miles and km in device settings.

0.3.0.en: Added support for geofence based trigger, miles/km support, l/GAL (US)/GAL (UK) support, improved error handling

0.4.0.en: Added condition cards for battery level, charging status and geofence location.

0.4.1.en: Fixed issue with location changed trigger if it is not in geofence.

0.5.0.en: Added Climate Cancel action card and Climate Started and Stopped trigger cards

0.6.1.en: Added support to enter captcha from https://bimmer-connected.readthedocs.io/en/stable/captcha/rest_of_world.html

0.6.4.en: Fixing issue with missing device during pairing caused by brand post filtering.

0.6.5.en: Prevented trip completion from triggering prematurely when the car auto-locks at the start of a drive.

0.7.0.en: Improved login flow. Added device repair capability. Removed username and password from configuration and is no longer persisted.

0.7.1.en: Fixing app crash caused by geo fencing detection code

0.7.4.en: Fixes issue where non (B/PH)EV might be detected as one.

0.7.5.en: Fixing an issue while updating settings.

0.7.6.en: Fixing readonly issue while updating settings

0.7.7.en: Changing device class and adding electric drive-train capabilities to support energy tab.

0.7.8.en: Added device setting to auto retry when device is unavailable. This allows to heal the device incase the api starts to respond again.

0.7.9.en: Fixed quota blocking by updating the library

0.8.0.en: Add support for basic charging control

0.8.1.en: Additional developer control to get status and capabilities

0.8.2.en: Add support for basic charging control (Fix)

1.0.11.en: App is now Read-Only. Switching to CarData API and MQTT streaming.

1.0.13.en: Fixed issue with running on Homey with Node v16.

1.0.15.en: Fix pairing for BMW sub-brand vehicles (e.g. BMW_I/iX), prevent token-polling crash on malformed auth responses, and preserve BMW error codes (CU-105) and messages from API responses.

1.0.16.en: Hardened OAuth device-code pairing: slow_down now extends polling interval per RFC 8628 instead of aborting; transient network errors during polling are retried instead of failing the whole auth window; container setup errors after successful auth are now clearly labelled; stale poll loops from earlier pairing attempts no longer race with new ones; requestDeviceCode retries once on transient network failure.

1.0.17.en: Pairing errors now show the real reason instead of "Unknown error" — including a hint to enable the "Streaming API" option on your BMW client when that's the cause

1.0.18.en: Re-pairing your car now reuses its existing BMW connection instead of creating a new one each time, and an interrupted pairing no longer leaves behind a car with no data. When something goes wrong, the error message now explains what actually happened instead of showing a generic failure.

1.0.19.en: The 'How to get a Client ID' link in the pairing screen now points to the MyBMW vehicle overview (the previous URL had moved and showed a 404). When BMW blocks a request because the daily limit of 50 requests per 24 hours has been reached, the app now clearly says so and asks you to wait, instead of incorrectly suggesting that the Streaming API option might be turned off.
